# UV Test Solutions

> Leading Indian supplier of test and measuring instruments — oscilloscopes, multimeters, signal generators, soldering stations, power tools and hand tools — from top global brands.

UV Test Solutions distributes precision electronic test, measurement and production equipment across India. We supply industry, R&D labs, educational institutions and government buyers (including via GeM) with instruments from brands like Keysight, Fluke, Tektronix, Rigol, Siglent, Hantek, Bakon, Kilews and more.
